# A tool server declared readonly offers and runs only what it marks as read only (L7):
# `mcpecho` marks `env` as read only, and not `echo`.

exec metagente check agent.ag
stdout 'No problems found'
exec metagente trust --yes agent.ag

exec metagente run agent.ag peek name=HOME
stdout '^value: '

! exec metagente run agent.ag say text=hello
stderr '`server.echo` is not available because `tool server` was declared readonly'
! stdout 'echo: hello'

-- agent.ag --
agent Reader
  goal "Read through a tool server, and never change anything with it"
  tool server from mcp "mcpecho" readonly
  accepts say text
  accepts peek name
  on say
    reply server.echo text: text
  on peek
    reply server.env name: name
